content: Iterative sampling: As described in Section SECREF6, there exists an extreme class imbalance for this binary classification task, in that the number of negative examples is far more than the number of positive examples. Here, we explore an iterative sampling technique to address this problem. We train our classifier for multiple iterations, coupling the same $\textrm {train}_{\textrm {pos}}$ with a new randomly sampled $\textrm {train}_{\textrm {neg}}$ set in each iteration.
